features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.desc: You copy Enchantment spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.desc: As an action, you charm a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom saving throw): it is Dazed as long as you maintain your gaze, using an action each turn.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.desc: As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet attacks you, you redirect the attack to another creature (Wisdom saving throw).

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.desc: You can target two creatures with Enchantment spells that normally target one.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.desc: When you end a charm, you can erase the target's memory of the time it spent charmed.
